name: Abstract API
label: Abstract API
description: Abstract API official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: ip_geolocate, phone_validate, email_validate, vat_validate, exchange_live, company_enrich, holiday_list. Docs: https://docs.abstractapi.com. Company Enrichment is Version 2 (https://docs.abstractapi.com/api/company-enrichment). Per-product AbstractAPI terms and keys. Phone/email are PII. Each product has its own key config (ip_geolocation_api_key, phone_validation_api_key, email_validation_api_key, vat_api_key, exchange_rates_api_key, company_enrichment_api_key, holidays_api_key); bind the ones for the operations you run. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Abstract API request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"ip_geolocate"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: ip_geolocate | phone_validate | email_validate | vat_validate | exchange_live | company_enrich | holiday_list. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'ip_geolocate'.

schema.label: base
schema.description: Currency base for exchange_rates. Example: USD.

schema.label: country
schema.description: ISO country for holidays. Example: US.

schema.label: domain
schema.description: Domain for company_enrichment or similar. Example: example.com.

schema.label: vat_number
schema.description: VAT number for vat_validate. Example: DE123456789.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: ip_geolocate, phone_validate, email_validate, vat_validate, exchange_live, company_enrich, holiday_list.

configurationParameters.label: IP Geolocation Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Abstract IP Geolocation API key, sent as query api_key by ip_geolocate (ipgeolocation.abstractapi.com). Abstract issues a distinct key per API, so this key works only for that product. Required only when that operation runs; leave blank otherwise. Bind a StudioQuack secret; never log, never put on INPUT. Example: <your-ip-geolocation-key>.
